name: board-vanity-statue
description: Vanity projects need a board (#2052): on a grade-5 sandbox with no board the Build menu has no Vanity section and `build ceo_statue` is refused with cash untouched. Once a board is attached (`board start`), the player builds the CEO Statue from the Vanity section: exactly $250,000 is charged, board confidence rises and average crew morale dips once (mandatory saluting).

steps.command: sandbox start biome:desert_badlands kit:full seed:42 staffed:true grade:5

interaction.command: sandbox start biome:desert_badlands kit:full seed:42 staffed:true grade:5

steps.description: Progression site opened at grade 5, the top of the ladder: no board attached.

Grade 5, no board: the player opens the Build menu and it offers no Vanity section at all (absent, not locked); cash untouched. Console refusal of `build ceo_statue` is covered by unit tests; here only the menu is read.

expect.note: #2052 -- no board, no Vanity section, at any grade. The section is absent from the DOM, which expect.blocked cannot assert (it refuses an absent selector), so the absence is read from the screenshot.

steps.description: Attach a board of directors (console-only primitive, no UI equivalent): quarter 1, confidence 60.
With a board attached, the Vanity section appears: build the CEO Statue by clicking. It costs exactly $250,000, board confidence rises and the crew's average morale dips (mandatory saluting).
Observe: the statue stands; the dip is a one-off, not a recurring drain.
